Tajweed Guide

Beginner-friendly rule summaries with Arabic examples.

Izhar — الإظهار

Pronounce Noon Sakinah or Tanween clearly before ء هـ ع ح غ خ.

مِنْ هَادٍ

Ikhfa — الإخفاء

Conceal Noon Sakinah or Tanween with ghunnah before the 15 Ikhfa letters.

مِنْ قَبْلُ

Iqlab — الإقلاب

Change Noon Sakinah or Tanween to a hidden Meem sound with ghunnah before ب.

مِنْ بَعْدِ

Idgham — الإدغام

Merge into ي ر م ل و ن. With ghunnah: ي ن م و; without ghunnah: ل ر.

Meem Sakinah — أحكام الميم الساكنة

Three rules: Ikhfa Shafawi before ب, Idgham Shafawi before م, and Izhar Shafawi before other letters.

Qalqalah — القلقلة

A slight echoing sound on ق ط ب ج د when sakin.

قُطْبُ جَدٍّ

Lam Shamsiyyah & Qamariyyah

In Shamsiyyah the Lam is not pronounced: الشَّمْسُ. In Qamariyyah it is pronounced: الْقَمَرُ.

Madd — المد

Natural Madd is generally two counts when its conditions are met. Other types have their own lengths.

قَالَ · يَقُولُ · قِيلَ

Ghunnah — الغنة

Nasal sound held for two counts in its applicable rules, including نّ and مّ.

Beginner summary only. Learn pronunciation and timing with a qualified Quran teacher.

بِلَا اتِّصَال

Offline Guide

Understand what works without internet and how to keep your progress safe.

Offline availability

Embedded app content and local counters work offline when this HTML file is saved on your device. Quran Surahs and Hadith sections are cached on this device after they load successfully once; open them online first to prepare offline copies. Prayer calculations, maps and external audio still require internet.

Important: Full background notifications and reliable PWA offline caching are not enabled in this downloaded HTML file. They require HTTPS hosting and a service worker.

Android tip

Keep this HTML file in Downloads and reopen it in Chrome. Avoid clearing Chrome site data if you want to retain locally saved progress.
